purpose: Frozen local CPU screening and human review, not replacement acceptance or macOS parity.
freeze_rule: Created before any candidate inference on these prepared inputs. Changes require a new criteria id and a new results directory.

preparation.embedded_icc: convert to sRGB using Pillow ImageCms if present; otherwise explicitly assume sRGB
preparation.reference_composite: 8-bit sRGB-domain straight-alpha blend; alpha is the published PNG channel

provider: Native OnnxSubjectProvider; mandatory CPU; ONNX Runtime 1.30.0; 8 intra-op, 1 inter-op; fresh process per image
reference_policy: Seven real photographs have no independent reference alpha: alpha error, reference boundary error, reference coverage recall and quality gate are null with reason qualitative_only. The eighth input uses an independently published historical cutout: metrics mean agreement with that published channel; its extraction method and physical accuracy are unknown. It is not a scientific ground-truth corpus. No model-generated matte is treated as ground truth.

definitions.boundary_mae: alpha MAE within an 8-pixel Euclidean band of the 4-connected inner boundary of reference_alpha>=0.5; include every pixel with 0<reference_alpha<1
definitions.foreground_recall: fraction of reference_alpha>=0.95 pixels for which predicted_alpha>=0.5
definitions.iou: intersection / union of predicted_alpha>=0.5 and reference_alpha>=0.5
definitions.boundary_f1: harmonic mean of predicted/reference 4-connected inner-boundary precision and recall; nearest boundary Euclidean tolerance 2 pixels
definitions.coverage_fraction: fraction of all image pixels with alpha>=0.5; observable area, not recall
definitions.soft_alpha_fraction: fraction of all image pixels with 0.05<alpha<0.95; does not establish physical transparency
definitions.basic_advanced_mae: mean absolute alpha difference between Basic and Advanced; does not establish accuracy
definitions.negative_case: Grass has no predesignated salient foreground object. Report rejection behavior and coverage; do not create a fabricated all-zero reference alpha.
definitions.memory: Fresh process Windows PeakWorkingSetSize after inference and refinement; private committed bytes measured at end; includes model/session. CPU latency splits model load, inference and refinement. One run per image: descriptive measurements, not a performance distribution.

threshold_status: Provisional engineering criteria frozen before measurement; not validated user acceptance thresholds. Both modes are scored without tuning.
